_: Everything this pipeline says out loud. Public-safe by design: account IDs, budgets and keys live in ~/.config/mwk-social/ and ~/.secrets, never here.
_marker: The duplicate guard keys off this exact substring. Every composed comment must contain it. Changing it is a breaking change: the watcher would stop recognising its own past comments and would comment again on every post.

tags._always: Every post, in this order. #PIY is the motto short form, #MWKShow is the brand and #MWK is the short brand tag. Three always-on tags leave Instagram only two topic slots — that is the price of the third one. "Prompt it Yourself" stays in the comment TEXT where it reads as a sentence — it is not a tag.
tags._caps: null = no meaningful cap. Instagram's 5 counts the caption AND the comments together.

firstComment._episodeMixRatio: Roughly this share of comments quote a real guest wish from the feed. The rest are the plain invitation. If the feed is unreachable, every comment falls back to a plain variant.
firstComment._register: Written informally on purpose — lowercase openings, dropped commas, 'dont'. Hand-written, never mangled at runtime, so every possible output has been read by a human. Never alter the URL and never break the marker.

one wish is one show. bring me something you wish your computer did, and we build it on your own machine while we talk.

{show}

if theres something you wish your computer did, thats the whole show. three to four hours, unedited.

{show}

dont let someone else prompt it for you. come and build the thing yourself.

{show}

no experience needed and no camera skills either. a real problem and your own computer is the whole list.

{show}

you keep what we build, and you can change it afterwards without me. thats the point of it.

{show}

somebodys problem, out of their own work, built on their own computer. thats one show.

{show}
